keyPoints.en: Climate (temperature, rainfall, sunlight) is the main factor; hot and wet → dense rainforest; dry → grass or desert plants.
keyPoints.bm: Iklim (suhu, hujan, cahaya matahari) faktor utama; panas dan lembap → hutan hujan tebal; kering → rumput atau tumbuhan gurun.

keyPoints.en: Relief/altitude: about −0.6 °C per 100 m, so higher areas have montane forest.
keyPoints.bm: Bentuk muka bumi/altitud: kira-kira −0.6 °C setiap 100 m, jadi kawasan tinggi mempunyai hutan pergunungan.

keyPoints.en: Soil and drainage: waterlogged land → swamp; salty muddy coasts → mangrove. Vegetation provides food and habitat for wildlife.
keyPoints.bm: Tanih dan saliran: tanah bertakung → paya; pantai berlumpur masin → bakau. Tumbuhan menyediakan makanan dan habitat kepada hidupan liar.

tip.en: Altitude questions: subtract 6 °C for every 1,000 m.
tip.bm: Soalan altitud: tolak 6 °C bagi setiap 1,000 m.
